svg.title: The book drifts smoothly from side to side
svg.text: The book drifts smoothly from side to side
Similarity of every side with every other (letters + trigrams), in book order 2a → 48b.
Neighbour similarity along Dee's order 91.19 vs random orders 84.29 (best of 500: 85.87);
a greedy 'smoothest' ordering reaches 91.51 — Dee's order is almost as smooth as it can be. Blocks = the segments.
Mirror pairs t ↔ 49−t (0.892) and same 7×7 plan column (0.892) are no closer than random pairs (0.893).
